archetypes.name: contract-drift
archetypes.rationale: The plan defines a 3-hop KV data pipeline (GitHub API → compute-pr-line-counts.sh → write-final-report.sh → render-run-summary.sh); variable names and format can drift silently between plan sections.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit every inter-component contract in the plan: the KV output names emitted by compute-pr-line-counts.sh (LINES_STATUS, CODE_ADDED, CODE_DELETED, LOGS_ADDED, LOGS_DELETED) against what write-final-report.sh is said to parse; the four flag names (--code-added, --code-deleted, --logs-added, --logs-deleted) passed to render-run-summary.sh against what render-run-summary.sh is said to accept; and the lines_disp format string against the assertion text in test-render-run-summary.sh. Flag any variable-name mismatch, missing KV key, or format inconsistency between plan sections as a plan defect. Also verify the plan accounts for write-final-report.sh's current argument-passing mechanism (positional argv array vs eval/export) when it appends optional line flags — if the plan assumes an argv-array pattern that does not exist in the current file, call it out. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: harness-gap
archetypes.rationale: The test strategy is detailed but the plan does not explicitly cover compose_self_fallback isolation and does not verify that the gh shim design in test-write-final-report.sh is complete for all nonzero-PR fixtures.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine each harness spec (test-compute-pr-line-counts.sh, test-render-run-summary.sh, test-write-final-report.sh) for coverage gaps against the plan's own stated behaviors. Check whether compose_self_fallback's new Lines bullet is exercised in any harness or left untested. Verify the plan's claim that a gh PATH shim is installed for every fixture with a nonzero PR_NUMBER — if earlier fixtures in test-write-final-report.sh predate this requirement their absence is a plan defect. Check that the empty-repo endpoint shape assertion (repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/<N>/files) is actually verifiable offline: the shim must record or echo the URL for the assertion to be mechanically possible, and the plan should describe how. Flag any test goal that cannot be verified by the harness as described. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
